top_signals.title: Singapore Bank Stocks Drop as High Bond Yields May Hit Earnings
top_signals.summary: Singapore bank shares extended declines for a second day after JPMorgan Chase & Co. warned that surging long bond yields will hurt third-quarter earnings for Southeast Asian lenders.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Trump says he is not keen on a deal with Iran as U.S. reportedly prepares for 'massive bombing'
top_signals.summary: Trump said he no longer wants to reach a deal with Iran amid reports that U.S. military are preparing for possible strikes against the Islamic state.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
